tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the store catalog. Returns title, price (UZS), delivery fee, availability, url and image. Product names are in Uzbek or Russian; short keywords in either language match best.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full product details: description, all images, video, variants (size/color with their own price and availability), delivery terms and the total to pay.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Store policies: delivery area, time and fee, cash-on-delivery payment, how orders are confirmed, returns and support contact.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places a real cash-on-delivery order for the shopper. A call-center operator phones the given number to confirm, then a courier delivers and collects payment. The order is accepted only with customer_confirmed=true, meaning the shopper explicitly confirmed the product, variant, total and phone numbe

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an order placed earlier. Requires the order id and the last 4 digits of the customer's phone.
